title: Mike Kelley: Exploded Fortress of Solitude

description.main: Catalogue of Mike Kelley's 2011 Gagosian exhibitions of Kandor sculptures, Beverly Hills and London, with an essay by Jeffrey Sconce.
description.extended:
The catalogue to Mike Kelley's two 2011 Gagosian shows built around the Kandor sculptures and the Extracurricular Activity Projective Reconstruction series.

It documents the Beverly Hills installation (January 11 to February 17, 2011) and the London installation at Britannia Street (September 8 to October 22, 2011), where Kandor 10B (Exploded Fortress of Solitude) was a walk-in cave of faux black rock holding a glowing city in a bottle. Jeffrey Sconce contributes the essay “When Worlds Collide.” Lorraine Wild and Victor Hu designed the book with Kelley. Mark Francis edited it. It runs to 203 pages.

Kelley (1954–2012) began the Kandor series in 1999, taking the bottled Superman city as a sculptural subject. The series sits beside his 365-part Extracurricular Activity Projective Reconstruction project.
